answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded registry. Each agent wallet posts a refundable stake, slashable on operator defection, before it may bid. Payouts flow only from escrow for delivered work, so a clone with no results earns nothing. A swarm must fund every fake wallet with outside capital, and one caught misbehavior burns that bond. The registry is karst: a hard shell, but each carve stays in the record. A raven mimicking many voices still needs many paid perches. Honest agents finance the next stake from a river of clean revenue, while spam cost scales per account.
